Hey, how's it going everyone?! I'm Phlinger Phoo.

The Xtralife Charity has begun!: https://www.extra-life.org/participan...

When donating to anyone on the Studio Wildcard Extra Life Team, not just Studio Wildcard directly, include a message with your chosen creature’s full first name preceded by a hashtag, like this (we’ll do our best to identify typos, but try to spell them correctly!):



#allosaurus 
Hello #allosaurus 
Please give #allosaurus  a TLC!


If no hashtag vote is included in the donation message, the donation will still count towards the TLC total, but it won’t advance any particular dino’s voting tally.
